purpose: Teach: 白色/股/壺/杭/便器/ふじ/カンガルー/凡人

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、白色のカフェオレボウルがお好みだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer really loves their white café au lait bowls, doesn't he.
lines.style: Warm, gentle observation. Soft voice, almost confiding. A small smile tucked into the words. Pace is unhurried, inviting Aoi into a shared understanding.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、自転車の股下サイズを気にされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah — and he was really particular about the inseam length on his bike, remember.
lines.style: Matching Mei's warmth but with a thread of amusement running underneath. Slight tilt toward conspiratorial. Speaking from genuine memory, not performing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、店先の壺、つまり信楽焼の壺をお褒め下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He actually complimented that Shigaraki pottery jar out front, didn't he.
lines.style: Gentle wonder in the voice. Noticing-aloud quality, like she's watching Mei realize something with her. Tender attention to the detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、店の駐輪場の杭、つまり杭を確認されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And he made a point of checking over the bike rack posts, all careful about that.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. A half-laugh quality underneath, not mocking but fond of his thoroughness. Delivered like offering Mei another piece of the picture.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お店の便器、つまりトイレの設備をお褒め下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He even had something nice to say about the restroom setup, believe it or not.
lines.style: Soft surprise and delight woven together. Light breath under the words. Slight rise at the end like it's still a small marvel to her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、富士、つまりふじ山麓のキャンプ場のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and he went on about that campsite near Mount Fuji, told us the whole story.
lines.style: Animated but contained warmth. The cadence of someone enjoying the memory of his storytelling. A little lift when mentioning the location.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、オーストラリアでカンガルーを観たって語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He told us he saw kangaroos in Australia once. Just like that.
lines.style: Gentle awe underneath. Pause before 'kangaroos' like the word itself is a small discovery. Trailing slightly, inviting Mei into the wonder of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご自身を「凡人ですから」って謙虚に仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: But when you asked about himself, he just said, 'Oh, I'm just an ordinary person,' so humble about it.
lines.style: Tender recognition, almost protective. Voice softens on the self-deprecation. A pause before 'ordinary' — capturing his modesty with care and affection. Trailing close.
